subject.title: feat(feeds): refresh and manage followed publishers

question: Should signed publisher-feed following be accepted as a permanent core Gateway/SQLite/CLI control plane, or should OpenClaw provide only any missing generic extension seam and leave publisher behavior to ClawHub or a plugin?
rationale: The branch adds a broad new product subsystem rather than repairing an established behavior, and repository policy makes optional integrations and service workflows plugin-first unless maintainers choose otherwise.

options.title: Keep it plugin-first
options.body: Do not merge the publisher-specific core control plane; identify and add only a narrowly reusable plugin or Gateway extension seam if an external implementation cannot be built today.

options.title: Sponsor the core subsystem
options.body: Explicitly accept publisher following as a core capability, then require a documented public contract, upgrade and lifecycle proof, and ownership for its security and availability boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep it plugin-first
recommendation.body: Do not merge the publisher-specific core control plane; identify and add only a narrowly reusable plugin or Gateway extension seam if an external implementation cannot be built today.
